caseName: Bank of America, N.A. v. Toledo-Cardona
caseNameFull: BANK OF AMERICA, N.A. v. Edelmiro TOLEDO-CARDONA

opinions.text: Motion of Loan Syndications and Trading Association, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 13-1421 granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit granted. The case is consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
